scope: Predictor-dev fit selection and exploratory accuracy-dev readouts only. All fits rescored by normalized logit MSE plus within-example state-change MSE, regardless of training loss. Forced ABC classification is not generated-answer accuracy. Positive logit-MSE reduction means better than unchanged initial-teacher logits; initial accuracy alone does not establish learning. Readout times exclude shared prefix cache and paid initial-teacher anchors, which remain in each protocol.
